notes: RecCheck is now Pro-Check. Same tool, a name that says what it is for: pro as in protel, check as in the things protel should have been checking on its own since the '80s. Only the name you see changed — Desktop, Start Menu, window, installer. Your data, your profiles and your bindings stay exactly where they were. From 1.17.62, if you skipped it: the τ shortcut is Enter, τ, Enter — always — and the invoice run starts with one more Enter.
